title: Massage Revelation
blurb: Massage Revelation is a by-appointment massage studio located in Bastrop, TX. They specialize in pain relief, tension reduction, and relaxation through soft tissue manipulation, joint decompression, joint mobilization, and stretching techniques. Therapists customize each session to fit the client's current needs through an integrative approach to healing bodywork.
